tools.name: open_tree
tools.description: Call first on every multi-step task, and again whenever you lost the tree id (e.g. after context compaction): the same ref always returns the same tree. Returns dead paths with reasons, human answers, pending questions and the outline. Creates the tree with goal as root if the ref is new.

tools.name: branch
tools.description: Add a child under parent (default root) before you try it. If its wording mostly overlaps a dead path anywhere in the tree, it is not added and you get that path's reason; rephrase if it is genuinely different, or pass retry_because with what changed.

tools.name: mark
tools.description: dead = the approach failed or is ruled out (reason required: it is what stops the next agent repeating it). chosen = the approach you commit to among siblings. done = finished (reason = evidence, e.g. PR link or test result).

tools.name: attach
tools.description: Attach a link (PR, preview deploy, issue, log, doc) to a node so the human can open it from the tree. The result also gives the one-line command to upload a screenshot (PNG/JPEG/WebP, up to 1.5 MB) to the same node; use it after you change anything visible.

tools.name: ask_human
tools.description: Only for a decision you cannot make from the code, docs or tree (taste, money, people outside the team, irreversible actions). Posts a question with 2-6 one-tap options and returns at once; keep working on other branches and read the answer later with open_tree. Returns the link to give your human.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: attach, ask_human · Public sink: attach.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: attach, ask_human · Public sink: attach

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
